statement: The executive, administrative, and professional exemptions from FLSA minimum wage and overtime require, among other tests, payment on a salary basis of not less than $684 per week under the regulation text in force as of its May 15, 2026 update (29 CFR § 541.600(a), 91 FR 27835).
caveat: The salary level has been the subject of repeated rulemaking and litigation (the 2024 increase was vacated); verify the live regulation before relying on the figure, and remember the duties tests must also be met — a salary alone exempts no one. This repo does not classify employees.
reviewer: Lane editorial review (law-map 2026-10-14); independent domain expert review pending
